fields.notes: PROFIBUS's protocol-level DFT surface is Slave_Diag (layered diagnostics), the FDL status request, the Live List, Get_Configuration, and per-telegram FCS/parity/timeout status. Chip-level JTAG / scan / BIST remain controller-vendor / SoC concerns; conformance is established by PI certification testing.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Slave_Diag (Get_Diag)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Layered station / module / channel / device diagnostics.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Get_Configuration
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Read back the slave's module configuration.

internal_diagnostics_observability: Slave startup state (POWER_ON / Wait_Prm / Wait_Cfg / Data_Exchange).
out_of_band_test_facilities: PI (PROFIBUS & PROFINET International) certification / interoperability testing.

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
